scope: Audit-reuse invalidation investigation and adversarial regression; no cache or production bypass enabled
review: One bounded read-only helper reviewed the existing scanner and tests while the lead examined compiler invocation and evidence boundaries. Helper is closed.
hypothesis: A file whose existence is tested by __has_include but never included might change selected code without changing the compiler dependency graph.
result: DISPROVED for the current Clang. Its -M output includes successful include-presence probes even without a corresponding include directive. The existing final graph guard rejects a late appearing file after the first TU has finished preprocessing.

test.ordering: Second TU waits for first TU preprocessing, then creates appears.hpp. First TU tests presence to select between two numeric declarations but never includes the file.

reuse_boundary_to_implement.payload: Per-TU semantic census after AST visitor, before live macro findings; never cache the live ledger/quantization verdict.
reuse_boundary_to_implement.admission: Start opt-in and caller-owned. Unsupported compiler wrappers, response/config files, plugins, volatile builtins, PCH and module inputs must disable reuse until their semantic inputs are explicitly represented.
reuse_boundary_to_implement.identity: Normalized absolute and manifest-relative source paths, ordered effective arguments, working directory, inherited environment, resolved actual compiler/toolchain identity, dependency graph and bytes, and live preprocessed evidence with line markers. Compiler name or version text alone is insufficient.
reuse_boundary_to_implement.hit_work: Retain live dependency discovery/snapshots, macro preprocessing/extraction, final byte/graph checks and fresh live registry verdict.
reuse_boundary_to_implement.publication: Publish entries only after complete scan success; maintain manifest-order findings and fail-closed concurrent-mutation behavior.

decision: Do not add a redundant preprocessing pass for the disproved probe hypothesis. Do not ship a source-only, timestamp-only or compiler-version-only cache. Implement the restricted compiler-context identity and unsupported-input admission policy before enabling reuse.
limits: Production scanner behavior and performance are unchanged. Compiler behavior was verified on the current host, not asserted for arbitrary tools. Safe reusable evidence, persistent reuse, full-manifest performance qualification and the wider engineering goal remain unfinished.
